children: Overview
US healthcare REIT's Q3 Adjusted FFO rose yr/yr, FAD also increased
Company completed $1.5 bln in new investments year-to-date, including $946 mln since quarter-end
Omega raised full-year 2026 Adjusted FFO guidance
Outlook
Omega raises 2026 AFFO guidance to $3.28-$3.30 per diluted share from $3.22-$3.26
Company expects to make further accretive investments through year-end and into early 2027
Omega says operating metrics remain robust, with operator coverage improving in the quarter
Result Drivers
NEW INVESTMENTS - Co completed $182 mln of investments in Q3 and $946 mln since quarter-end, including acquisitions of care facilities and funding of real estate loans

PORTFOLIO RESTRUCTURING - Co converted two U.K. operator relationships covering 30 care homes to RIDEA structures for $48 mln and transitioned 32 Florida SNFs to a new operator, increasing annual rent
OPERATOR COVERAGE IMPROVEMENT - Co said operator coverage ratios and operating metrics improved in the quarter
